 function confirmLine(input,index,reference,reviewer,v2BaseReviewed,ctx){const p=validate(input),r=p.races[index];if(!r||r.card.sport!=='keirin'||!r.identity)fail('出走者の独立照合が必要です');I.assertRace(r.identity,{...r.card,lines:undefined},p.dataKind,ctx.now);if(Q.hash({...r.identity.candidate,lines:r.card.lines})!==Q.hash(r.card))fail('照合後に出走者または出所が変更されています');I.sourcePermission(r.identity,p.policy,ctx.now);r.lineEvidence={format:'RACELAB_LINE_CONFIRMATION_V1',reference:I.card(reference),reviewer,reviewedAt:ctx.now,identityHash:Q.hash(r.identity),lineHash:Q.hash(r.card.lines),referenceHash:Q.hash(I.card(reference)),v2Hash:Q.hash(r.v2),ratingsHash:Q.hash(r.ratings),v2BaseReviewed};lineVerified(r,p,ctx);return validate(p);}
 function inspect(input,index,ctx){const p=validate(input),r=p.races[index];if(!r)fail('レースを選択してください');const errors=[],warnings=[];let identity={ready:false,reviewed:0,total:r.card.count,rows:[],errors:[]},lineOK=false;if(r.lineEvidence)try{lineOK=lineVerified(r,p,ctx);}catch(e){errors.push(e.message);}if(!p.policy)errors.push('利用条件が未確認です。ローカル分析・保存の条件を確認してください');else{const g=M.gate({...p.policy,analysisMethod:'USER_ONLY'},ctx);if(!g.allowed)errors.push(...g.reasons);}
  if(!r.identity)errors.push('本人照合は未確認。別資料または保存済み照合記録を追加してください');else try{const ref=r.identity.reference,can=r.card;if(ref.source.reference===can.source.reference&&ref.source.kind!=='USER_IMAGE_CHECK')fail('候補と同一の出所を独立名簿として扱えません');I.assertRace(r.identity,{...can,entries:can.entries,lines:undefined},p.dataKind,ctx.now);if(Q.hash({...r.identity.candidate,lines:can.lines})!==Q.hash(can))fail('照合後に出走者または出所が変更されています');if(Q.hash(r.identity.candidate.lines)!==Q.hash(can.lines)&&!lineOK)fail('ラインが変更されています。新しい構成の出所と確認が必要です');if(p.policy)I.sourcePermission(r.identity,p.policy,ctx.now);identity=I.inspect(r.identity,ctx.now);}catch(e){identity=I.inspect(r.identity,ctx.now);errors.push(e.message);}
  let lines={groups:[],positions:[]};if(r.card.sport==='keirin')try{lines=I.parseLines(r.card.lines.notation,r.card.entries.map(e=>e.number),r.card.lines.status);}catch(e){errors.push(e.message);}if(r.card.sport==='keirin'&&r.v2?.analysis?.races?.[0]?.lines){const v=r.v2.analysis.races[0].lines;if(Q.hash(v.groups)!==Q.hash(lines.groups)||v.status!==r.card.lines.status){if(!lineOK)errors.push('V2原評価のラインと現在のラインが異なります。評価根拠の再確認が必要です');else warnings.push('V2原評価は旧ライン条件のまま保持。新ラインの根拠として流用しません。基礎点の分離は利用者確認です。');}}if(r.card.sport==='horse'&&(r.conditions.distanceMetres==null||r.conditions.surface==null))errors.push('競馬の距離・芝/ダートが未確認');if(r.card.sport==='keirin'&&r.conditions.bankLengthMetres==null)errors.push('競輪のバンク条件が未確認');if(r.card.entries.some(e=>e.stableId===null))warnings.push('安定IDは未取得を含みます。番号・氏名の照合であり実人の認証ではありません');if(r.ratings.some(e=>e.score===null))warnings.push('能力点に未評価があります。均等仮定では能力点を使用しません');if(Date.parse(ctx.now)>=Date.parse(r.card.startsAt))warnings.push('発走後の実行は事後分析です。事前予測とは扱いません');warnings.push('利用条件と本人照合は申告記録です。真正性を認証していません');return {ready:errors.length===0&&identity.ready,errors,warnings,identity,lines};
 }
 function toJSON(p){return limited(JSON.stringify(validate(p),null,2));}
 const HEADERS=['形式','区分','レースID','競技','開催日','会場','レース番号','出走番号','名前','枠番','能力点','ぶれ','出所','共通JSON','SHA256'];
 const enc=s=>/^[=+\-@'\t\r\n]/.test(s)?"'"+s:s,dec=s=>s[0]==="'"&&/^[=+\-@'\t\r\n]/.test(s.slice(1))?s.slice(1):s;
 function flat(p){return p.races.flatMap(r=>r.card.entries.map(e=>{const a=r.ratings.find(a=>a.number===e.number);return [FORMAT,p.dataKind,r.card.raceId,r.card.sport,r.card.date,r.card.venue,r.card.raceNo,e.number,e.name,e.frame??'',a.score??'',a.sigma??'',r.card.source.reference].map(String);}));}
 function toCSV(input){const p=validate(input),h=Q.hash(p),rows=flat(p);return limited(H.serializeCSV([HEADERS,...rows.map((r,i)=>[...r,i===0?JSON.stringify(p):'',h].map(s=>enc(String(s))))]));}
 function fromCSV(s){const rows=H.parseCSV(limited(s));if(Q.hash(rows[0])!==Q.hash(HEADERS)||rows.length<2)fail('対応するRaceLab取込CSV形式ではありません（既存39列とは別形式）');const first=rows[1].map(dec),p=validate(JSON.parse(first[13])),h=Q.hash(p),expected=flat(p);if(expected.length!==rows.length-1)fail('CSVの欠員/重複');for(let i=0;i<expected.length;i++){const r=rows[i+1].map(dec);if(r.length!==15||r[14]!==h||r[13]!== (i===0?JSON.stringify(p):'')||Q.hash(r.slice(0,13))!==Q.hash(expected[i]))fail('CSV表示列/共通情報/SHA不一致');}return p;}
 function toText(p){p=validate(p);return p.dataKind+' / RaceLab一括資料\n'+p.races.map(r=>r.card.venue+' '+r.card.raceNo+'R / '+r.card.sport+' / '+r.card.count+'名').join('\n')+'\n```json\n'+toJSON(p)+'\n```';}
 function parse(s){limited(s);const t=s.trim().replace(/^\uFEFF/,'');if(t.startsWith('形式,')||t.startsWith('"形式"'))return fromCSV(t);if(!t.startsWith('{')&&!t.startsWith('```')&&!t.startsWith('REAL')&&!t.startsWith('TEST_FIXTURE')&&!t.startsWith('SYNTHETIC')&&!t.includes('```'))fail('対応するJSON/CSV/構造化テキスト形式を指定してください');const v=M.parseJSON(t);if(v.format==='RACELAB_IDENTITY_WORKSPACE_V1')fail('旧全作業ファイルは「既存機能→出走表照合」で復元できます。新一括資料はテンプレートを使用してください');return validate(v);}
 function addReference(input,index,reference,policy,at){const p=validate(input),r=p.races[index];reference=I.card(reference);if(reference.source.reference===r.card.source.reference||reference.source.sourceId===r.card.source.sourceId)fail('同じ入力候補は独立資料として扱えません');let s=I.create(reference,r.card,p.dataKind);const q=I.inspect(s,at);if(q.errors.length)fail('別資料との不一致: '+q.errors.map(x=>x.message).join(' / '));p.policy=M.policyValidate(policy);I.sourcePermission(s,p.policy,at);for(const e of reference.entries)s=I.review(s,e.number,'INDEPENDENT_SOURCE_COMPARISON',reference.source.reference+' / '+e.number+'番・独立資料との一致（真正性認証なし）',at);r.identity=s;return validate(p);}
 function applyScore(input,index,number,score,sigma,reason,at){const p=validate(input),r=p.races[index],a=r.ratings.find(a=>a.number===number);if(!a)fail('未知番号');text(reason,'修正理由',2000);if(!reason.trim())fail('修正理由が必要です');a.notes+='\nUSER '+at+' / '+reason+' / before='+String(a.score)+' / after='+String(score);a.score=score;a.sigma=sigma;return validate(p);}
 function setLines(input,index,notation,status){const p=validate(input),r=p.races[index];if(!r||r.card.sport!=='keirin')fail('競輪レースを選択してください');text(notation,'ライン',300);I.parseLines(notation,r.card.entries.map(e=>e.number),status);const next={notation:notation.trim(),direction:'LEADER_TO_FOLLOWER',status};if(Q.hash(next)!==Q.hash(r.card.lines)){r.card.lines=next;delete r.lineEvidence;}return validate(p);}
 function selectedRace(input,index){const p=validate(input);if(!Number.isInteger(index)||!p.races[index])fail('レースを選択してください');p.races=[p.races[index]];if(p.policy){const known=new Set(p.policy.sources.map(s=>s.id)),used=new Set();function scan(x){if(!x||typeof x!=='object')return;if(Array.isArray(x)){x.forEach(scan);return;}for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(x)){if((k==='sourceId'||k==='id')&&typeof v==='string'&&known.has(v))used.add(v);scan(v);}}scan(p.races[0]);p.policy.sources=p.policy.sources.filter(s=>used.has(s.id));}return validate(p);}
 function selectedArchive(input,index,runs,ctx){const current=selectedRace(input,index);if(!current.policy)fail('ローカル利用条件が未確認です');const gate=M.gate({...current.policy,analysisMethod:'USER_ONLY'},ctx);if(!gate.allowed)fail(gate.reasons.join(' / '));if(!Array.isArray(runs)||runs.length>20)fail('履歴は20件以内です');const raceId=current.races[0].card.raceId,inputs=new Map([[Q.hash(current),current]]),out=[];let total=0;for(const run of runs){if(!run?.inputs||!Number.isInteger(run.raceIndex)||!run.inputs.races?.[run.raceIndex])fail('実行履歴の入力が欠けています');if(run.inputs.races[run.raceIndex].card.raceId===raceId){if(!Number.isInteger(run.options?.runs)||run.options.runs<1)fail('履歴の試行回数が不正です');total+=run.options.runs;if(total>200000)fail('選択履歴の再現計算は合計200000回以内です');}}for(const run of runs){if(!run?.inputs||!Number.isInteger(run.raceIndex)||!run.inputs.races?.[run.raceIndex])fail('実行履歴の入力が欠けています');if(run.inputs.races[run.raceIndex].card.raceId!==raceId)continue;const oldCard=run.inputs.races[run.raceIndex].card;if(run.dataKind!==current.dataKind||['sport','date','venue','raceNo','startsAt'].some(k=>oldCard[k]!==current.races[0].card[k]))fail('履歴の競技区分またはレース条件が不一致です');const verified=restoreRun(JSON.stringify(run),run.inputs,ctx),single=selectedRace(run.inputs,run.raceIndex),replayed=RaceSimulationCore.run(single,0,run.options,{...ctx,now:run.executedAt});for(const key of ['stats','combinations','example','scenario','options','temporalStatus'])if(Q.hash(verified[key])!==Q.hash(replayed[key]))fail('選択レースの再計算と元の実行結果が不一致です');inputs.set(Q.hash(single),single);const saved=clone(replayed);delete saved.inputs;out.push(saved);}const body={format:'RACELAB_IMPORT_ARCHIVE_V1',dataKind:current.dataKind,currentInputHash:Q.hash(current),inputs:[...inputs].map(([hash,pack])=>({hash,pack})),runs:out};return {...body,contentHash:Q.hash(body)};}
 function saveRun(value){const v=clone(value),h=v.contentHash;delete v.contentHash;if(v.format!==RUN||h!==Q.hash(v))fail('実行記録のSHA不一致');return limited(JSON.stringify({...v,contentHash:h},null,2));}
 function restoreRun(s,p,ctx){const v=M.parseJSON(limited(s)),h=v.contentHash;delete v.contentHash;if(v.format!==RUN||h!==Q.hash(v))fail('実行記録のSHA不一致');if(v.inputHash!==Q.hash(validate(p)))fail('異なる入力への実行記録です');if(Date.parse(v.executedAt)>Date.parse(ctx.now))fail('未来の実行記録');const fresh=RaceSimulationCore.run(p,v.raceIndex,v.options,{...ctx,now:v.executedAt});if(fresh.contentHash!==h)fail('実行記録の再現不一致');return {...v,contentHash:h};}
 function candidateValidate(input){limited(JSON.stringify(input));const p=clone(input);if(p.format!=='RACELAB_CANDIDATE_V1'||!['REAL','SYNTHETIC','TEST_FIXTURE'].includes(p.dataKind)||!Array.isArray(p.races)||!p.races.length||p.races.length>50)fail('候補形式・区分・レース数が不正');for(const r of p.races){if(!['horse','keirin'].includes(r.sport)||r.raceNo!==null&&(!Number.isInteger(r.raceNo)||r.raceNo<1||r.raceNo>99)||!Array.isArray(r.entries)||!r.entries.length||r.entries.length>(r.sport==='horse'?18:9))fail('候補レース条件不正');for(const k of ['date','venue','startsAt'])if(r[k]!==null&&typeof r[k]!=='string')fail('候補 '+k+'不正');if(r.date!==null&&(!/^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d$/.test(r.date)||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(r.date))||new Date(r.date+'T00:00:00Z').toISOString().slice(0,10)!==r.date))fail('候補日付不正');if(r.startsAt!==null&&(!/^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d(?:Z|[+-]\d\d:\d\d)$/.test(r.startsAt)||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(r.startsAt))||r.date!==null&&r.startsAt.slice(0,10)!==r.date))fail('候補時刻と開催日が不一致');if(!r.source||typeof r.source.reference!=='string'||!r.source.reference.trim())fail('候補出所未確認');const seen=new Set(),names=new Set();for(const e of r.entries){if(!Number.isInteger(e.number)||e.number<1||e.number>(r.sport==='horse'?18:9)||seen.has(e.number)||typeof e.name!=='string'||!e.name.trim()||names.has(e.name))fail('候補番号・氏名の重複/不正');seen.add(e.number);names.add(e.name);if(e.stableId!==null&&typeof e.stableId!=='string')fail('安定ID不正');if(!e.stats||typeof e.stats!=='object'||Array.isArray(e.stats))fail('観測値不足');for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(e.stats)){if(v!==null&&(!Number.isFinite(v)||v<0))fail('候補観測値不正');if(v!==null&&['winRate','secondRate','thirdRate'].includes(k)&&v>100)fail('候補率は0〜100');if(v!==null&&['escape','makuri','sashi','mark','back','home','start','first','second','third','unplaced'].includes(k)&&!Number.isInteger(v))fail('候補回数は整数');}}if(!r.lines||typeof r.lines.notation!=='string'||!['UNKNOWN','UNCONFIRMED'].includes(r.lines.status))fail('候補ラインは未確認です');}return p;}
 function pdfObservedMeta(r,stats){const e=r?.pdfEvidence;if(!e?.source||!e.race||!Array.isArray(e.race.headerCells))return {};const text=e.race.headerCells.map(x=>x.text||'').join('').normalize('NFKC').replace(/\s+/gu,'');if(!text.includes('直近4ヶ月成績')||!/^([a-f0-9]{64})$/.test(e.source.documentSHA256||'')||!e.source.acquiredAt||!r.card?.source?.reference)return {};const period='PDF掲載「直近4ヶ月」/ 文書 '+e.source.documentSHA256;return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(stats).filter(([,v])=>v!==null&&v!==undefined).map(([k])=>[k,{period,acquiredAt:e.source.acquiredAt,reference:r.card.source.reference,periodEvidence:'PDF見出し: 直近4ヶ月成績（集計開始日の詳細は未確認）'}]));}
 function candidateFromPack(input){const p=validate(input);return candidateValidate({format:'RACELAB_CANDIDATE_V1',dataKind:p.dataKind,races:p.races.map(r=>({sport:r.card.sport,date:r.card.date,venue:r.card.venue,raceNo:r.card.raceNo,startsAt:r.card.startsAt,source:{reference:r.card.source.reference,acquiredAt:r.card.source.availableAt,...(r.pdfEvidence?{fingerprint:r.pdfEvidence.source.documentSHA256}:{})},entries:r.card.entries.map(e=>{const o=r.pdfEvidence?.rows.find(x=>x.number===e.number);const stats={};for(const k of ['escape','makuri','sashi','mark','back','home','start','winRate','secondRate','thirdRate','first','second','third','unplaced'])stats[k]=o?.observed?.[k]?.value??null;stats.score=o?.competitionScore?.value??null;return {number:e.number,name:e.name,stableId:e.stableId,stats,statMeta:pdfObservedMeta(r,stats)};}),lines:{notation:r.card.lines.notation,status:r.card.lines.notation?'UNCONFIRMED':'UNKNOWN'}}))});}
 function candidateFormalize(input,index,formalPack,ctx){const p=candidateValidate(input),r=p.races[index];if(r?.bookmarkSafety)RaceBookmark1123.assertReady(r);if(!r||!r.startsAt||!r.date||!r.venue||!r.raceNo)fail('正式登録に必要な開催情報・発走時刻が不足/未確認');if(!formalPack||!ctx)fail('本人照合・利用条件・時点の検証が必要です');const f=validate(formalPack);if(f.dataKind!==p.dataKind||f.races.length!==1)fail('正式候補の区分・レース数が不一致');const card=f.races[0].card;for(const k of ['sport','date','venue','raceNo','startsAt'])if(card[k]!==r[k])fail('正式出走表と候補の'+k+'が不一致');const roster=x=>x.entries.map(e=>[e.number,e.name,e.stableId]).sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]);if(Q.hash(roster(card))!==Q.hash(roster(r)))fail('正式出走表と候補の出走者が不一致');const checked=inspect(f,0,ctx);if(!checked.ready)fail('正式登録の確認不足: '+checked.errors.join(' / '));if(Date.parse(ctx.now)>=Date.parse(card.startsAt)||Date.parse(card.source.availableAt)>=Date.parse(card.startsAt))fail('事前時点が確認できません');return f;}
 function candidateSameRace(a,b){if(!a||!b)return false;const venue=x=>typeof x==='string'?x.normalize('NFKC').replace(/\s+/gu,'').replace(/競輪場$/u,'競輪'):null;return a.sport===b.sport&&a.date!==null&&a.date===b.date&&typeof a.venue==='string'&&!!a.venue.trim()&&typeof b.venue==='string'&&!!b.venue.trim()&&venue(a.venue)===venue(b.venue)&&a.raceNo!==null&&a.raceNo===b.raceNo;}
 function candidateMerge(left,leftIndex,right,rightIndex){const pa=candidateValidate(left),pb=candidateValidate(right);if(pa.dataKind!==pb.dataKind)fail('REAL/架空の区分が不一致');let a=pa.races[leftIndex],b=pb.races[rightIndex];if(!a||!b)fail('レース選択が不正');for(const r of [a,b])if(r.bookmarkSafety)RaceBookmark1123.assertReady(r);if(!candidateSameRace(a,b))fail('レース情報が不一致/未確認');if(a.startsAt&&b.startsAt&&a.startsAt!==b.startsAt)fail('発走時刻が不一致');const timeLimit=a.startsAt||b.startsAt||null,startsAt=a.startsAt&&b.startsAt?a.startsAt:null;for(const s of [a.source,b.source])if(!s.reference||!/^([a-f0-9]{64})$/.test(s.fingerprint||'')||!/^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d(?:Z|[+-]\d\d:\d\d)$/.test(s.acquiredAt||'')||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(s.acquiredAt))||new Date(s.acquiredAt.slice(0,10)+'T00:00:00Z').toISOString().slice(0,10)!==s.acquiredAt.slice(0,10))fail('資料の参照・ハッシュ・取得時刻が未確認');if(a.source.reference===b.source.reference||a.source.fingerprint===b.source.fingerprint)fail('同一資料のコピーを独立資料と扱えません');if(timeLimit&&[a.source,b.source].some(x=>Date.parse(x.acquiredAt)>=Date.parse(timeLimit)))fail('事後の取得時点を事前データに混ぜられません');const order=r=>r.entries.slice().sort((x,y)=>x.number-y.number);const aa=order(a),bb=order(b);if(Q.hash(aa.map(e=>[e.number,e.name,e.stableId]))!==Q.hash(bb.map(e=>[e.number,e.name,e.stableId])))fail('出走者が不一致');const comparisons=[],entries=aa.map((x,i)=>{const y=bb[i],stats={};for(const k of new Set([...Object.keys(x.stats),...Object.keys(y.stats)])){const av=x.stats[k]??null,bv=y.stats[k]??null,ap=x.statMeta?.[k]?.period??null,bp=y.statMeta?.[k]?.period??null;let status;if(av===null&&bv===null)status='MISSING_BOTH';else if(av===null||bv===null)status='MISSING_ONE';else if((x.statMeta?.[k]?.acquiredAt&&x.statMeta[k].acquiredAt!==a.source.acquiredAt)||(y.statMeta?.[k]?.acquiredAt&&y.statMeta[k].acquiredAt!==b.source.acquiredAt))status='TIME_MISMATCH';else if(!ap||!bp)status='PERIOD_UNKNOWN';else if(ap!==bp)status='PERIOD_MISMATCH';else if(av!==bv)status='CONFLICT';else status='MATCH';stats[k]=status==='MATCH'?av:null;comparisons.push({number:x.number,field:k,status,values:[av,bv],periods:[ap,bp],sourceReferences:[a.source.reference,b.source.reference],acquiredAt:[a.source.acquiredAt,b.source.acquiredAt]});}return {...x,stats};});return {format:'RACELAB_CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_V1',independence:'NOT_AUTHENTICATED',temporalStatus:timeLimit?'SELF_REPORTED_PRE_START':'UNKNOWN_START',dataKind:pa.dataKind,race:{...a,...(!a.bookmarkSafety&&b.bookmarkSafety?{bookmarkSafety:b.bookmarkSafety}:{}),startsAt,entries,lines:{notation:'',status:'UNKNOWN'}},comparison:comparisons};}
 return Object.freeze({FORMAT,RUN,MAX,HEADERS,validate,inspect,parse,toJSON,toCSV,toText,fromCSV,addReference,applyScore,setLines,confirmLine,selectedRace,selectedArchive,saveRun,restoreRun,candidateValidate,pdfObservedMeta,candidateFromPack,candidateFormalize,candidateSameRace,candidateMerge});
})();

</script>
<script id="text-parser">
'use strict';
globalThis.RaceImportText=(()=>{
 const K=RaceImportCore,H=RaceHistoryCore;
 const nullable=s=>s===''||s==='null'||s==='未確認'?null:s;
 function parse(raw,provenance){if(typeof raw!=='string'||new TextEncoder().encode(raw).length>K.MAX)throw Error('文字資料は2MiB以内です');if(raw.includes('\uFFFD'))throw Error('文字を復元できません。一括JSON/テキストで確認してください');if(raw.trim().startsWith('{')||raw.includes('```json'))return K.parse(raw);if(/^(?:\uFEFF)?(?:競技,|"競技",)/.test(raw.trim()))return fromFlatCSV(raw,provenance);const lines=raw.replace(/^\uFEFF/,'').split(/\r?\n/).map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean),groups=[];let meta=Object.create(null),rows=[],header=null,kind='REAL';
  function finish(){if(!rows.length&&!Object.keys(meta).length)return;if(!rows.length)throw Error('出走表の表を判別できません。抽出テキストを整理して一括貼付してください');const required=['競技','開催日','会場','レース番号','レースID','発走予定','出走数','確認時刻','利用可能時刻'];for(const k of required)if(!meta[k])throw Error(k+'が未確認です。構造化テキスト/JSONで補足してください');const sport=({'競輪':'keirin','競馬':'horse',keirin:'keirin',horse:'horse'})[meta['競技']];if(!sport)throw Error('競技を確認してください');const sourceId=meta.sourceId||provenance.sourceId,reference=provenance.reference;const entries=[],ratings=[];
   for(const cells of rows){if(cells.length!==header.length)throw Error('出走行の列数が不一致です。省略せず再確認してください');const o=Object.fromEntries(header.map((h,i)=>[h,cells[i]]));if(!/^\d+$/.test(o['番号']||''))throw Error('出走番号が不正です');const number=Number(o['番号']);entries.push({number,name:o['名前'],frame:nullable(o['枠番']??'')===null?null:Number(o['枠番']),stableId:nullable(o['安定ID']??''),status:o['出走状態']||'UNKNOWN'});ratings.push({number,score:nullable(o['能力点']??'')===null?null:Number(o['能力点']),sigma:nullable(o['ぶれ']??'')===null?null:Number(o['ぶれ']),style:o['脚質']||'',notes:o['根拠']||''});}
   const card={sport,raceId:meta['レースID'],date:meta['開催日'],venue:meta['会場'],raceNo:Number(meta['レース番号']),startsAt:meta['発走予定'],count:Number(meta['出走数']),numberType:'ENTRANT_NUMBER',entries,source:{sourceId,reference,checkedAt:meta['確認時刻'],availableAt:meta['利用可能時刻'],kind:'AI_EXTRACTED',independentFromCandidate:false},lines:{notation:sport==='keirin'?(meta['ライン']||''):'',direction:'LEADER_TO_FOLLOWER',status:sport==='horse'?'UNKNOWN':({'予想':'PREDICTED','確認済申告':'CONFIRMED_BY_USER','不明':'UNKNOWN'})[meta['ライン状態']]||'UNKNOWN'}};
   groups.push({card,ratings,conditions:sport==='horse'?{distanceMetres:nullable(meta['距離']||'')===null?null:Number(meta['距離']),surface:nullable(meta['芝ダート']||''),going:nullable(meta['馬場']||''),pace:nullable(meta['展開']||'')}:{bankLengthMetres:nullable(meta['バンク長']||'')===null?null:Number(meta['バンク長']),raceClass:nullable(meta['クラス']||'')},identity:null,v2:null,features:null});meta=Object.create(null);rows=[];header=null;
  }
  const aliases={'車番':'番号','馬番':'番号','出走番号':'番号','選手名':'名前','馬名':'名前','氏名':'名前','枠':'枠番','評価点':'能力点'};
  const metadata=['競技','開催日','会場','レース番号','レースID','発走予定','出走数','確認時刻','利用可能時刻','sourceId','ライン','ライン状態','距離','芝ダート','馬場','展開','バンク長','クラス'];
  for(const line of lines){if(/^(RACELAB_CARD_V1|TEST_FIXTURE・独自架空|#)/.test(line))continue;const kindLine=line.match(/^(?:資料区分|区分)\s*[:：]\s*(REAL|TEST_FIXTURE|SYNTHETIC)$/);if(kindLine){if(groups.length||rows.length)throw Error('区分は文書冒頭に1回だけ指定してください');kind=kindLine[1];continue;}if(/^---+$/.test(line)){finish();continue;}const m=line.match(/^([^:：,\t]+)\s*[:：]\s*(.*)$/);if(m){if(header&&rows.length)throw Error('表の後にメタ情報があります。レース区切りを入れてください');const key=m[1].trim();if(!metadata.includes(key))throw Error('未対応メタ項目: '+key+'。事後情報等を黙って省略しません');if(meta[key]!==undefined)throw Error('メタ項目が重複しています: '+key);meta[key]=m[2].trim();continue;}const cells=(line.includes(',')?H.parseCSV(line)[0]:line.split(/\t+|\s{2,}/)).map(s=>s.trim());if(!header){header=cells.map(h=>aliases[h]||h);if(!header.includes('番号')||!header.includes('名前')||new Set(header).size!==header.length)throw Error('表見出しの番号/名前を特定できません。一括JSON/CSVを使用してください');const allowed=['番号','名前','枠番','安定ID','能力点','ぶれ','脚質','根拠','出走状態'];if(header.some(h=>!allowed.includes(h)))throw Error('未対応の表列があります。競走得点を能力点へ自動変換しません');}else rows.push(cells);}
  finish();return K.validate({format:K.FORMAT,dataKind:kind,policy:null,races:groups});
 }
 function fromFlatCSV(raw,provenance){const rows=H.parseCSV(raw),header=rows.shift(),required=['競技','区分','レースID','開催日','会場','レース番号','発走予定','出走数','確認時刻','利用可能時刻','番号','名前','出走状態'],entrant=['番号','名前','枠番','安定ID','能力点','ぶれ','脚質','根拠','出走状態'],meta=['競技','開催日','会場','レース番号','レースID','発走予定','出走数','確認時刻','利用可能時刻','ライン','ライン状態','距離','芝ダート','馬場','展開','バンク長','クラス'];if(required.some(k=>!header.includes(k))||new Set(header).size!==header.length||header.some(k=>![...meta,...entrant,'区分'].includes(k)))throw Error('標準の平坦CSV列を確認してください。未知の列は省略しません');const groups=new Map(),kinds=new Set();for(const row of rows){if(row.length!==header.length)throw Error('CSV列数不一致');const obj=Object.fromEntries(header.map((k,i)=>[k,row[i]])),key=obj['競技']+'|'+obj['レースID'];kinds.add(obj['区分']);if(!groups.has(key))groups.set(key,[]);const values=groups.get(key);if(values.length&&meta.some(k=>obj[k]!==values[0][k]))throw Error('同一レースのCSV共通項目が不一致');values.push(obj);}if(kinds.size!==1)throw Error('REAL/TEST_FIXTURE/SYNTHETICの混在または空CSV');const lines=['資料区分: '+[...kinds][0]];for(const values of groups.values()){if(lines.length>1)lines.push('---');for(const k of meta)if(values[0][k]!==undefined&&values[0][k]!=='')lines.push(k+': '+values[0][k]);const cols=entrant.filter(k=>header.includes(k));lines.push(H.serializeCSV([cols,...values.map(v=>cols.map(k=>v[k]))]).replace(/^\uFEFF/,''));}return parse(lines.join('\n'),provenance);}
 return Object.freeze({parse,fromFlatCSV});
})();

</script>
<script id="bookmark-v1123">
'use strict';
globalThis.RaceBookmark1123=(()=>{
 const VERSION='11.23-core-auto-only-master-pattern-no-odds-line-reference-footer-boundary-fix';
 const VERSION_1124='11.24-dom-verified-no-odds-strict';
 const numericKeys=['score','s','b','nige','makuri','sashi','marking','winRate','ren2','ren3'];
 const norm=s=>String(s??'').normalize('NFKC').replace(/\s+/gu,'');
 function inspect1124(r,entries,comments){
  const reasons=[],lv=r.lineVerification,ready=r.systemReadiness;
  const add=s=>{if(!reasons.includes(s))reasons.push(s);};
  if(!lv||lv.domConfirmed!==true||r.lineSource!=='footerLineDOM')add('並び予想DOM未確認');
  if(!lv||lv.specialContested!==false)add('競り・ジカの確認不足');
  if(r.manualLineRequired!==false||r.validForPrediction!==true||ready?.lineReady!==true||ready?.lineGroupOK!==true||r.lineGroupCheck?.ok!==true)add('ライン検証が未完了');
  if(ready?.oddsReady!==false)add('オッズ非取得の確認不足');
  if(!Array.isArray(lv?.issues))add('ライン検証情報が不足');
  else if(lv.issues.length)add('ラインとコメントの不一致・競り等を検出');
  const groups=r.lineGroups,ids=entries.map(e=>String(e.number));let valid=false;
  if(Array.isArray(groups)&&groups.length>0&&groups.every(g=>Array.isArray(g)&&g.length>0&&g.every(x=>/^[1-9]$/.test(String(x))))){
   const flat=groups.flat().map(String);valid=flat.length===ids.length&&new Set(flat).size===ids.length&&flat.every(x=>ids.includes(x));
   if(valid){const expected=groups.map(g=>g.map(String).join('-')).join('/');const stated=norm(r.line).replace(/[－―ー→]/g,'-').replace(/[／|｜]/g,'/');if(stated!==expected||norm(r.lineSeq)!==flat.join('-'))add('ライン表記と構成が不一致');}
  }
  if(!valid)add('ラインに欠員・重複・不正があります');
  if(/ジカ|競り|競合|直付け|直競り/.test(norm(lv?.rawFooter)))add('競り・ジカを含むライン');
  const followers=new Map();
  for(const e of entries){const comment=comments[String(e.number)]||'',s=norm(comment);if(/ジカ|競り|競合|直付け|直競り/.test(s))add('コメントに競り・ジカがあります');
   const refs=new Set();for(const m of s.matchAll(/([1-9])(?:番車|号車|車番)/g))refs.add(m[1]);for(const other of entries)if(other.number!==e.number&&norm(other.name)&&s.includes(norm(other.name)))refs.add(String(other.number));
   for(const m of s.matchAll(/([\u3400-\u9fff]{1,9})(?:君|さん)/g)){const matches=entries.filter(x=>x.number!==e.number&&norm(x.name).startsWith(m[1]));if(matches.length!==1)add('コメントの選手名参照が未解決・曖昧です');else refs.add(String(matches[0].number));}
   if(refs.size>1)add('コメント参照先が複数あります');
   for(const ref of refs){if(ref===String(e.number)||!ids.includes(ref)){add('コメント参照先が不正');continue;}if(valid){const group=groups.find(g=>g.map(String).includes(String(e.number)));const seq=group?.map(String)||[];if(!seq.includes(ref)||seq.indexOf(ref)>=seq.indexOf(String(e.number)))add('コメントとラインが不一致');}
    if(!/3番手|三番手|4番手|四番手/.test(s)){if(!followers.has(ref))followers.set(ref,[]);followers.get(ref).push(e.number);}
   }
  }
  if([...followers.values()].some(x=>x.length>1))add('同一選手に複数の番手指定があります');
  const diagnostics=Array.isArray(lv?.diagnostics)?lv.diagnostics.filter(x=>typeof x==='string'&&x.length<=800&&/^(?:EXTRACTOR_REVISION=|HEADING_COUNT=|ORIGIN_VERIFIED=|CANDIDATE=|CLASSIFICATION=)/.test(x)).slice(0,20):[];return {version:VERSION_1124,hold:reasons.length>0,reasons,rawLine:typeof r.line==='string'?r.line:'',lineSource:typeof r.lineSource==='string'?r.lineSource:'',domConfirmed:lv?.domConfirmed===true,diagnostics};
 }
 function parse(text){
  if(typeof text!=='string'||new TextEncoder().encode(text).length>2*1024*1024)throw Error('貼付は2MiB以内');
  const i=text.indexOf('{'),j=text.lastIndexOf('}');if(i<0||j<i)throw Error('対応する出走情報がありません');
  let v;try{v=JSON.parse(text.slice(i,j+1));}catch{throw Error('JSON形式を解釈できません');}
  if(v.version!==VERSION&&v.version!==VERSION_1124)throw Error('未対応のブックマークレット版。オッズ版は対応していません');
  const is24=v.version===VERSION_1124;
  if(!Array.isArray(v.races)||!v.races.length||v.races.length>50||v.raceCount!==v.races.length||typeof v.createdAt!=='string')throw Error('出走情報のレース数・取得時刻が不正');
  const raceNos=new Set(),races=[];
  for(const r of v.races){const no=Number(r.race);if(!Number.isInteger(no)||no<1||no>12||raceNos.has(no))throw Error('レース番号重複/不正');raceNos.add(no);
   if(!Array.isArray(r.entries)||!Number.isInteger(r.entryCount)||r.entryCount!==r.entries.length||r.carCount!==r.entryCount||r.expectedCarCount!==r.entryCount||r.entryCount<3||r.entryCount>9||typeof r.title!=='string'||typeof r.url!=='string')throw Error('人数または開催情報の不一致');
   let comments={};if(is24){if(r.comments===null||typeof r.comments!=='object'||Array.isArray(r.comments))throw Error('選手コメントの形式が不正');comments=r.comments;}
   const seen=new Set(),names=new Set(),entries=[];
   for(const e of r.entries){const n=Number(e.car),name=typeof e.name==='string'?e.name.normalize('NFKC').replace(/\s+/gu,''):'';if(!Number.isInteger(n)||n<1||n>9||!name||seen.has(n)||names.has(name))throw Error('選手番号・氏名が重複または不明');seen.add(n);names.add(name);
    const observed={};for(const k of numericKeys){let z=e[k];if(z===undefined||z===null||z===''||z==='-'){observed[k]=null;continue;}if(!/^(?:\d+)(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(String(z)))throw Error(n+'番 '+k+' の数値が不正');let val=Number(z);if(!Number.isFinite(val)||val<0||(['winRate','ren2','ren3'].includes(k)&&val>100))throw Error(n+'番 '+k+' の値が範囲外');observed[k]=val;}
    const entry={number:n,name,observed,style:typeof e.leg==='string'?e.leg:'',pref:typeof e.pref==='string'?e.pref:'',grade:typeof e.grade==='string'?e.grade:''};
    if(is24){const comment=comments[String(n)];if(comment!==undefined&&(typeof comment!=='string'||comment.length>4000))throw Error(n+'番のコメントが不正');entry.comment=comment??'';}entries.push(entry);
   }
   if(is24&&Object.keys(comments).some(k=>!seen.has(Number(k))||!/^\d$/.test(k)))throw Error('出走者とコメントの車番が不一致');
   const safety=is24?inspect1124(r,entries,comments):null;
   races.push({raceNo:no,title:r.title,url:r.url,entries,line:typeof r.line==='string'?r.line:'',lineStatus:'UNCONFIRMED',...(safety?{bookmarkSafety:safety}:{})});
  }
  return {version:v.version,createdAt:v.createdAt,races};
 }
 function toCandidates(text,dataKind,acquiredAt=null){const p=parse(text);return RaceImportCore.candidateValidate({format:'RACELAB_CANDIDATE_V1',dataKind,races:p.races.map(r=>{const m=r.title.normalize('NFKC').match(/(\d{4})年(\d{1,2})月(\d{1,2})日/);const date=m?m[1]+'-'+m[2].padStart(2,'0')+'-'+m[3].padStart(2,'0'):null;const venueMatch=r.title.normalize('NFKC').match(/^([^\s|]{1,30}競輪)\s+レース詳細(?:\s|\|)/);const venue=venueMatch?venueMatch[1]:null;const hold=r.bookmarkSafety?.hold;return {sport:'keirin',date,venue,raceNo:r.raceNo,startsAt:null,title:r.title,source:{reference:r.url,acquiredAt,claimedAt:p.createdAt,fingerprint:RaceQualityCore.sha256(text)},entries:r.entries.map(e=>({number:e.number,name:e.name,stableId:null,style:e.style,grade:e.grade,pref:e.pref,...(e.comment!==undefined?{comment:e.comment}:{}),stats:{escape:e.observed.nige,makuri:e.observed.makuri,sashi:e.observed.sashi,mark:e.observed.marking,back:e.observed.b,start:e.observed.s,score:e.observed.score,winRate:e.observed.winRate,secondRate:e.observed.ren2,thirdRate:e.observed.ren3}})),lines:{notation:hold?'':r.line,status:!hold&&r.line?'UNCONFIRMED':'UNKNOWN'},...(r.bookmarkSafety?{bookmarkSafety:r.bookmarkSafety}:{})};})});}
 function holdReason(r){const v=r?.bookmarkSafety;if(!v)return '';if(v.version!==VERSION_1124||typeof v.hold!=='boolean'||!Array.isArray(v.reasons))return 'ライン検査記録が不正';if(v.hold)return v.reasons.join(' / ')||'ライン検査が未完了';const normalized=x=>norm(x).replace(/[－―ー→]/g,'-').replace(/[／|｜]/g,'/');if(normalized(r.lines?.notation)!==normalized(v.rawLine))return '入力ラインが抽出ラインと不一致';return '';}
 function assertReady(r){const reason=holdReason(r);if(reason)throw Error('分析HOLD: '+reason);}
 return Object.freeze({VERSION,VERSION_1124,parse,toCandidates,holdReason,assertReady});
})();

<script id="observed-stats">
'use strict';
// Only a verified, complete column header profile is parsed. Raw cells are retained.
globalThis.RaceObservedStats=(()=>{
 const VERSION='OBSERVED_KEIRIN_V1',keys=['escape','makuri','sashi','mark','back','home','start','winRate','secondRate','thirdRate','first','second','third','unplaced'];
 const labels=['逃','捲','差','マ','B','H','S','勝率','2連','3連','1','2','3','着'];
 const norm=s=>s.normalize('NFKC').replace(/\s+/g,'');
 function anchors(page,h){let out=[];for(const [i,label] of labels.entries()){
  const hits=page.items.filter(x=>x.x>h.score.right&&(!out.length||x.x>out[out.length-1].x)&&x.y<=h.bottom+2&&x.y>=h.bottom-32&&norm(x.text)===label);
  if(hits.length!==1)return null;out.push({key:keys[i],x:hits[0].x+hits[0].width/2,cell:hits[0]});
 }if(out.some((x,i)=>i&&x.x-out[i-1].x<5))return null;return out;}
 function extract(page,h,carY,number){const a=anchors(page,h);if(!a)return null;const result={};for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++){
   const left=i?(a[i-1].x+a[i].x)/2:(h.score.right+a[i].x)/2,right=i+1<a.length?(a[i].x+a[i+1].x)/2:a[i].x+(a[i].x-a[i-1].x)/2;
   const cells=page.items.filter(x=>Math.abs(x.y-carY)<3&&x.x+x.width/2>=left&&x.x+x.width/2<right&&norm(x.text));
   if(cells.length>1)throw Error('PDF HOLD: '+number+'番 '+a[i].key+' の列対応が曖昧');
   let value=null,raw=cells.length?norm(cells[0].text):'';if(raw){if(!/^\d{1,3}$/.test(raw))throw Error('PDF HOLD: '+number+'番 '+a[i].key+' は未対応の値');value=Number(raw);if(i>=7&&i<=9&&value>100)throw Error('PDF HOLD: '+number+'番 割合が範囲外');}
   result[a[i].key]={value,raw,cells,header:a[i].cell,missingReason:raw?'':'欄が空または抽出不能'};
 }return result;}
 function validate(s){if(s===null)return s;if(!s||typeof s!=='object'||Object.keys(s).length!==keys.length)throw Error('PDF HOLD: 観測列の形式不正');let prev=-1;for(let i=0;i<keys.length;i++){const z=s[keys[i]];if(!z||!z.header||norm(z.header.text)!==labels[i]||!Number.isFinite(z.header.x)||z.header.x<=prev||!Array.isArray(z.cells)||z.cells.length>1)throw Error('PDF HOLD: 観測列と見出しの整合性不正');prev=z.header.x;const raw=z.cells.length?norm(z.cells[0].text):'';if(raw!==z.raw||(!raw&&z.value!==null)||(raw&&(!/^\d{1,3}$/.test(raw)||Number(raw)!==z.value))||i>=7&&i<=9&&z.value!==null&&z.value>100)throw Error('PDF HOLD: 観測値と原セルが不一致');}return s;}
 function scoreRanks(values){if(!Array.isArray(values)||values.some(x=>x!==null&&(!Number.isFinite(x)||x<0)))throw Error('掲載得点が不正');return values.map(x=>x===null?null:1+values.filter(y=>y!==null&&y>x).length);}
 function evaluate(s){return {version:VERSION,lead:{value:s?.escape?.value??null,formula:'掲載逃回数そのまま',unit:'回'},makuri:{value:s?.makuri?.value??null,formula:'掲載捲回数そのまま',unit:'回'},sashi:{value:s?.sashi?.value??null,formula:'掲載差回数そのまま',unit:'回'},startCount:{value:s?.start?.value??null,formula:'掲載S回数そのまま',unit:'回'},position:{value:null,formula:'S回数から位置取り能力を推定しない',unit:null},stamina:{value:null,formula:'十分な観測値なし',unit:null},form:{value:null,formula:'近走内容・相手関係が不足',unit:null}};}
 return Object.freeze({VERSION,keys,anchors,extract,validate,scoreRanks,evaluate});
})();

<script id="integrated-analysis">
'use strict';
globalThis.RaceIntegratedAnalysis=(()=>{
 const VERSION='OBSERVATION_RELATIVE_V1',keys=['escape','makuri','sashi','mark'];
 function evaluate(entries){if(!Array.isArray(entries)||!entries.length||entries.length>18)throw Error('出走者数不正');const seen=new Set();for(const e of entries){if(!Number.isInteger(e.number)||e.number<1||seen.has(e.number))throw Error('番号重複/不正');seen.add(e.number);for(const k of keys)if(e[k]!=null&&(!Number.isInteger(e[k])||e[k]<0))throw Error('観測回数不正');}
 return entries.map(e=>({number:e.number,version:VERSION,metrics:Object.fromEntries(keys.map(k=>{const value=e[k]??null,known=entries.map(x=>x[k]).filter(x=>x!=null);return [k,{value,rank:value===null?null:1+known.filter(n=>n>value).length,comparable:known.length,unit:'回',method:'同一項目の掲載回数を降順順位付け。同点同順位。母数・対象期間が異なる場合は単純比較に制限'}]})),unknown:{form:null,stamina:null,venue:null},coverage:keys.filter(k=>e[k]!=null).length}));}
 return Object.freeze({VERSION,evaluate});
})();

<script id="observed-scenario">
'use strict';
// Experimental, uncalibrated model. All inputs must be observed and pre-race.
globalThis.RaceObservedScenario=(()=>{
 const VERSION='OBSERVED_SCENARIO_EXPERIMENTAL_V1',fields=['escape','makuri','sashi','mark','first','second','third','unplaced'];
 function run(candidate,index,formalPack,ctx,opts){const candidatePack=RaceImportCore.candidateValidate(candidate),r=candidatePack.races[index];if(!r)throw Error('レース不足');const official=RaceImportCore.candidateFormalize(candidatePack,index,formalPack,ctx),race=official.races[0];if(!opts||!Number.isInteger(opts.runs)||opts.runs<1||opts.runs>10000||typeof opts.seed!=='string'||!opts.seed||opts.seed.length>100)throw Error('試行回数/シード不正');if(r.source.reference!==race.card.source.reference)throw Error('観測値の出所が正式資料と不一致');if(r.sourceContributions){if(!Array.isArray(r.sourceContributions)||r.sourceContributions.length>8||!r.sourceContributions.length||new Set(r.sourceContributions.map(s=>s.reference)).size!==r.sourceContributions.length||!r.sourceContributions.some(s=>s.reference===r.source.reference)||r.sourceContributions.some(s=>typeof s.reference!=='string'||!official.policy.sources.some(p=>p.reference===s.reference)))throw Error('観測値の全出所の利用条件が未確認');}const lines=RaceIdentityCore.parseLines(race.card.lines.notation,race.card.entries.map(e=>e.number),race.card.lines.status);if(!lines.groups.length)throw Error('ライン不足');const participants=[];let period=null;for(const e of r.entries){const stats=e.stats||{};for(const k of fields){const value=stats[k],meta=e.statMeta?.[k];if(!Number.isInteger(value)||value<0)throw Error(e.number+'番 '+k+' 観測値欠損');if(!meta||typeof meta.period!=='string'||!meta.period||!/^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d(?:Z|[+-]\d\d:\d\d)$/.test(meta.acquiredAt||'')||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(meta.acquiredAt))||new Date(meta.acquiredAt.slice(0,10)+'T00:00:00Z').toISOString().slice(0,10)!==meta.acquiredAt.slice(0,10)||Date.parse(meta.acquiredAt)>Date.parse(ctx.now)||Date.parse(meta.acquiredAt)>Date.parse(race.card.source.checkedAt)||Date.parse(meta.acquiredAt)>=Date.parse(race.card.startsAt)||meta.reference!==r.source.reference)throw Error(e.number+'番 '+k+' 出所/時点が未確認');if(period===null)period=meta.period;if(meta.period!==period)throw Error('参照期間が不一致');}const n=stats.first+stats.second+stats.third+stats.unplaced;if(n<1||stats.escape+stats.makuri+stats.sashi+stats.mark>stats.first+stats.second)throw Error('母数と決まり手が不整合');const group=lines.groups.findIndex(g=>g.includes(e.number));if(group<0)throw Error('ライン欠員');participants.push({number:e.number,period,denominator:n,escape:stats.escape/n,makuri:stats.makuri/n,sashi:stats.sashi/n,mark:stats.mark/n,group,place:lines.groups[group].indexOf(e.number)+1});}
 const rng=RacePocCore.seededRandom(opts.seed),wins=Object.fromEntries(participants.map(e=>[e.number,0])),controllers=Object.fromEntries(participants.map(e=>[e.number,0])),firstTrace=null;let trace=firstTrace;for(let i=0;i<opts.runs;i++){const leaders=participants.filter(x=>x.place===1),ordered=leaders.map(x=>({n:x.number,group:x.group,score:x.escape+rng()})).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.n-b.n),controller=ordered[0],out=participants.map(e=>({number:e.number,score:e.makuri+e.sashi+(e.place===2&&e.group===controller.group?e.mark:0)+rng()})).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.number-b.number);wins[out[0].number]++;controllers[controller.n]++;if(!trace)trace={controller:controller.n,controllerScores:ordered,order:out.map(x=>x.number),finishScores:out};}return {version:VERSION,notice:'仮定係数の未校正試算。実戦の的中確率・購入推奨ではない',inputsHash:RaceQualityCore.hash({candidate:candidatePack,formalPack:official}),period,runs:opts.runs,seed:opts.seed,lines:lines.groups,participants,stats:participants.map(x=>({number:x.number,wins:wins[x.number],controllers:controllers[x.number]})),firstTrace:trace};}
 function record(candidate,formalPack,ctx,opts){const c=RaceImportCore.candidateValidate(candidate),p=RaceImportCore.validate(formalPack);if(c.races.length!==1||p.races.length!==1)throw Error('記録は選択1レースのみ');const result=run(c,0,p,ctx,opts),body={format:'RACELAB_OBSERVED_RUN_V1',candidate:c,formalPack:p,options:opts,executedAt:ctx.now,result};return {...body,contentHash:RaceQualityCore.hash(body)};}
 function restore(input,ctx){const v=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(input)),h=v.contentHash;delete v.contentHash;if(v.format!=='RACELAB_OBSERVED_RUN_V1'||h!==RaceQualityCore.hash(v))throw Error('実行記録SHA不一致');if(!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(v.executedAt))||Date.parse(v.executedAt)>Date.parse(ctx.now))throw Error('実行時刻が未来/不正');const p=RaceImportCore.validate(v.formalPack),g=RaceIdentityBase.M.gate({...p.policy,analysisMethod:'USER_ONLY'},ctx);if(!g.allowed)throw Error('利用条件未確認: '+g.reasons.join(' / '));const fresh=record(v.candidate,p,{...ctx,now:v.executedAt},v.options);if(fresh.contentHash!==h)throw Error('実行記録を再計算できません');return fresh;}
 function compare(a,b,ctx){a=restore(a,ctx);b=restore(b,ctx);if(RaceQualityCore.hash(a.candidate)!==RaceQualityCore.hash(b.candidate)||RaceQualityCore.hash(a.options)!==RaceQualityCore.hash(b.options))throw Error('同じ観測資料・シード・回数が必要');const ar=a.formalPack.races[0],br=b.formalPack.races[0];if(RaceQualityCore.hash({...ar.card,lines:br.card.lines})!==RaceQualityCore.hash(br.card)||['identity','v2','ratings','features','conditions'].some(k=>RaceQualityCore.hash(ar[k])!==RaceQualityCore.hash(br[k])))throw Error('個人評価・出走者・条件が異なります');if(RaceQualityCore.hash(ar.card.lines)===RaceQualityCore.hash(br.card.lines))throw Error('異なるラインが必要');return {notice:'未校正の仮定モデルの出現回数。的中確率ではありません。',A:a.result.lines,B:b.result.lines,rows:a.result.stats.map(x=>{const y=b.result.stats.find(z=>z.number===x.number);if(!y)throw Error('出走者不一致');return {number:x.number,winsA:x.wins,winsB:y.wins,controllersA:x.controllers,controllersB:y.controllers};}),traceA:a.result.firstTrace,traceB:b.result.firstTrace};}
 return Object.freeze({VERSION,fields,run,record,restore,compare});
})();

</script>
<script id="keirinjp-pdf">
'use strict';
// Geometry-based mapping for a KEIRIN.JP-style print card. No network or scoring.
globalThis.RaceKeirinPDF=(()=>{
 const VERSION='KEIRINJP_PRINT_CANDIDATE_2',FORMAT='RACELAB_PDF_MAPPING_EVIDENCE_V1';
 const norm=s=>s.replace(/⼾/g,'戸').replace(/⻄/g,'西').replace(/⻑/g,'長').normalize('NFKC'),compact=s=>norm(s).replace(/\s+/gu,''),clone=x=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x));
 const fail=s=>{throw Error('PDF HOLD: '+s);};
 const time=(s,label)=>{if(typeof s!=='string'||!/^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d(?:Z|[+-]\d\d:\d\d)$/.test(s)||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(s))||new Date(s.slice(0,10)+'T00:00:00Z').toISOString().slice(0,10)!==s.slice(0,10)||Number(s.slice(11,13))>23||Number(s.slice(14,16))>59||Number(s.slice(17,19))>59)fail(label+'のローカル観測時刻が不正');return s;};
 function rows(items){const result=[];for(const item of items.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.y-b.y||a.x-b.x||a.id.localeCompare(b.id))){let row=result.find(r=>Math.abs(r.y-item.y)<2);if(!row){row={y:item.y,items:[]};result.push(row);}row.items.push(item);}for(const row of result){row.items.sort((a,b)=>a.x-b.x||a.id.localeCompare(b.id));row.text=row.items.map(x=>x.text).join(' ');row.compact=compact(row.text);}return result;}
 function label(all,label){
  const hits=[];
  for(const row of all){let text='',positions=[];for(const item of row.items){const chars=Array.from(compact(item.text));chars.forEach((ch,i)=>{text+=ch;positions.push({x:item.x+item.width*i/Math.max(1,chars.length),right:item.x+item.width*(i+1)/Math.max(1,chars.length)});});}
   let start=text.indexOf(label);while(start>=0){const left=positions[start].x,right=positions[start+label.length-1].right;hits.push({x:left,right,center:(left+right)/2,y:row.y,label});start=text.indexOf(label,start+1);}}
  return hits;
 }
 function vertical(all,upper,lower){const a=label(all,upper),b=label(all,lower);return a.flatMap(x=>b.filter(y=>y.y>x.y&&y.y-x.y<28&&Math.abs(y.center-x.center)<12).map(y=>({...x,label:upper+lower,yBottom:y.y})));}
 function header(all){
  const names=label(all,'選手名'),candidates=[];
  for(const name of names){
   const region=all.filter(r=>Math.abs(r.y-name.y)<=25);
   const unique=list=>list.length===1?list[0]:null;
   const car=unique(label(region,'車番').length?label(region,'車番'):vertical(region,'車','番'));
   const score=unique(label(region,'競走得点').length?label(region,'競走得点'):vertical(region,'競走','得点'));
   if(!car||!score||!(car.center<name.center&&score.center>name.center))continue;
   const composite=region.some(r=>/府県\/級班(?:前現)?\/脚質/.test(r.compact));
   const style=composite?null:unique(label(region,'脚質'));
   if(style&&style.center<=name.center)continue;
   const frame=unique(label(region,'枠番').length?label(region,'枠番'):vertical(region,'枠','番'));
   const extra=['期別','年齢','府県','級班','ギヤ倍数','ギア倍数','逃','捲','差','マ','B','H','S','勝率','着外','直近成績'].flatMap(t=>label(region,t));
   // Embedded prefecture/class/style belong to the name cell, not extra columns.
   const rightOfName=extra.filter(x=>x.x>name.right&&(!composite||!['府県','級班'].includes(x.label)));
   name.left=car.right;name.end=Math.min(score.x,...rightOfName.map(x=>x.x));
   const left=[frame,...label(region,'印')].filter(x=>x&&x.center<car.center).map(x=>x.center);
   car.left=left.length?(Math.max(...left)+car.center)/2:0;car.end=name.left;
   const beforeScore=[...extra,...[style].filter(Boolean)].filter(x=>x.right<score.x&&x.x>=name.end);
   score.left=beforeScore.length?(Math.max(...beforeScore.map(x=>x.right))+score.x)/2:(name.right+score.x)/2;
   const afterScore=extra.filter(x=>x.x>=score.right);score.end=afterScore.length?(score.right+Math.min(...afterScore.map(x=>x.x)))/2:Infinity;
   if(style){const allAnchors=[name,score,...extra].filter(x=>x.center!==style.center);const l=allAnchors.filter(x=>x.center<style.center),r=allAnchors.filter(x=>x.center>style.center);style.left=l.length?(Math.max(...l.map(x=>x.center))+style.center)/2:0;style.end=r.length?(Math.min(...r.map(x=>x.center))+style.center)/2:Infinity;}
   if(frame){frame.left=0;frame.end=(frame.center+car.center)/2;}
   const bottom=Math.max(...region.filter(r=>r.y>=name.y).map(r=>r.y));
   const stops=[...names.filter(n=>n.y>bottom+5).map(n=>n.y-5),...all.filter(r=>r.y>bottom+5&&/誘導|コメント|直近成績/.test(r.compact)).map(r=>r.y-5)];
   candidates.push({car,name,score,style,frame,composite,bottom,end:stops.length?Math.min(...stops):Infinity,headingCount:names.length});
  }
  if(candidates.length!==1)fail('車番・選手名・競走得点を備える出走表本体が一意でありません（候補'+candidates.length+'）');
  return candidates[0];
 }
 function metadata(all,h){
  const head=all.filter(r=>r.y<h.bottom-20),text=head.map(r=>r.compact).join('');
  const dates=[...text.matchAll(/(\d{4})年(\d{1,2})月(\d{1,2})日/g)].map(m=>m[1]+'-'+m[2].padStart(2,'0')+'-'+m[3].padStart(2,'0'));
  if(new Set(dates).size!==1)fail('開催日が不足/曖昧です');const date=dates[0];if(new Date(date+'T00:00:00Z').toISOString().slice(0,10)!==date)fail('開催日が不正です');
  const venues=head.flatMap(r=>[...r.compact.matchAll(/([^0-9\s/()（）:：]{2,30}競輪場)/g)].map(m=>m[1]));if(new Set(venues).size!==1)fail('競輪場名を一意に判別できません');
  const nums=[...text.matchAll(/(?:^|[^\d])([1-9]\d?)R(?![A-Z])/g)].map(m=>Number(m[1]));if(new Set(nums).size!==1)fail('1ページ1レースの番号を一意に判別できません');
  const starts=[...text.matchAll(/発走予定(?:時刻)?[:：]?(\d{1,2})[:時](\d{2})/g)];if(starts.length!==1||Number(starts[0][1])>23||Number(starts[0][2])>59)fail('発走予定時刻が不足/曖昧です');
  return {date,venue:venues[0],raceNo:nums[0],startsAt:date+'T'+starts[0][1].padStart(2,'0')+':'+starts[0][2]+':00+09:00'};
 }
 const nameText=s=>compact(s).replace(/\((?:追加|補充)\)$/u,'');
 const inColumn=(item,col)=>col&&item.x>=col.left&&item.x<col.end;
 function nameRow(all,car,gap,h){
  const candidates=[];for(const row of all.filter(r=>Math.abs(r.y-car.y)<gap*.46&&r.y>h.bottom)){const cells=row.items.filter(x=>inColumn(x,h.name));const raw=cells.map(x=>x.text).join(' '),name=nameText(raw);if(!name||/[\/0-9]/u.test(name))continue;
   if(/^[\p{Script=Han}\p{Script=Hiragana}\p{Script=Katakana}々ヶー・]+$/u.test(name))candidates.push({y:row.y,name,raw,cells});}
  if(candidates.length!==1)fail(car.number+'番の氏名行が不足/曖昧です（候補'+candidates.length+'）');return candidates[0];
 }
 function values(body,col){return rows(body.filter(x=>inColumn(x,col))).map(r=>({raw:r.items.map(x=>x.text).join(' '),value:compact(r.text),cells:r.items})).filter(x=>x.value);}
 function parsePage(page,document,ctx,kind){
  const all=rows(page.items),h=header(all),meta=metadata(all,h),prefix=meta.raceNo+'R / ページ'+page.number+' / ';
  const footer=all.filter(r=>r.y>page.height*.6&&/印刷|https?:\/\/|www\.keirin\.jp/i.test(r.text)).map(r=>r.y),end=Math.min(h.end,footer.length?Math.min(...footer):page.height);
  const carRows=rows(page.items.filter(x=>x.y>h.bottom+3&&x.y<end&&inColumn(x,h.car))).filter(r=>/^\d+$/.test(r.compact)).map(r=>({number:Number(r.compact),y:r.y,cells:r.items}));
  if(![7,9].includes(carRows.length)||carRows.some((r,i)=>r.number!==i+1))fail(prefix+'車番は1〜7または1〜9の連続・各1行が必要です。重複/欠員/不明を確認してください');
  const count=carRows.length,gap=Math.min(...carRows.slice(1).map((r,i)=>r.y-carRows[i].y));if(gap<18)fail(prefix+'出走行の間隔が曖昧です');
  const names=carRows.map(car=>nameRow(all,car,gap,h)),entries=[],ratings=[],facts=[],warnings=[],normalizations=[];
  for(const [i,car]of carRows.entries()){
   const name=names[i],top=name.y-5,bottom=i+1<names.length?names[i+1].y-5:Math.min(end,name.y+gap),body=page.items.filter(x=>x.y>=top&&x.y<bottom);
   if(new Set(names.map(n=>n.name)).size!==count)fail(prefix+'氏名が重複しています。推測名寄せしません');
   const scores=values(body,h.score);let point=null,rawPoint=scores.map(x=>x.raw).join(' / ');if(scores.length===1&&/^\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}$/.test(scores[0].value))point=Number(scores[0].value);else if(scores.length>1||/\d/.test(rawPoint))fail(prefix+car.number+'番の得点と行の対応が曖昧です');else warnings.push(car.number+'番の競走得点は欠損/特殊表現（0へ変換しない）');
   const styles=h.composite?values(body,h.name).filter(x=>/\/(?:[ASL][1-3]){1,2}\/(逃|追|両)$/.test(x.value)).map(x=>({...x,value:x.value.slice(-1)})):values(body,h.style);let style=null;if(styles.length===1&&/^(逃|追|両|先行|捲り|差し|自在|追込)$/.test(styles[0].value))style=styles[0].value;else if(styles.length>1)fail(prefix+car.number+'番の脚質が曖昧です');else warnings.push(car.number+'番の脚質は未確認');
   const frameValues=values(body,h.frame);let frame=null;if(frameValues.length===1&&/^[1-6]$/.test(frameValues[0].value))frame=Number(frameValues[0].value);else if(frameValues.length)warnings.push(car.number+'番の枠は未解釈・車番に代用しない');
   const statusText=body.map(x=>compact(x.text));let status='ACTIVE';if(statusText.some(s=>/^(欠場|欠車|取消|出走取消)$/.test(s)))status='CANCELLED';if(statusText.some(s=>/^(除外|競走除外)$/.test(s)))status='EXCLUDED';
   entries.push({number:car.number,name:name.name,frame,stableId:null,status});ratings.push({number:car.number,score:null,sigma:null,style:style||'',notes:'PDF掲載競走得点: '+(point===null?'未確認':point)+'。能力点へ未変換。本人・利用条件は未確認。'});
   const observed=RaceObservedStats.extract(page,h,car.y,car.number);
   facts.push({observed,number:car.number,name:name.name,rawName:name.raw,nameCells:clone(name.cells),numberCells:clone(car.cells),competitionScore:{value:point,raw:rawPoint,cells:clone(scores.flatMap(x=>x.cells)),meaning:'PDF_LISTED_COMPETITION_SCORE_NOT_ABILITY'},style,styleCells:clone(styles.flatMap(x=>x.cells))});
  }
  for(const item of page.items)if(norm(item.text)!==item.text)normalizations.push({id:item.id,raw:item.text,normalized:norm(item.text)});
  if(all.some(r=>r.compact.startsWith('並び予想')&&!r.compact.includes(':')&&!r.compact.includes('：')))warnings.push('図形式の並び予想は掲載されていますが未解釈です。ラインUNKNOWNを維持');
  const historyHeader=all.filter(r=>r.compact.includes('直近1')&&r.compact.includes('直近2')&&r.compact.includes('直近3'));if(historyHeader.length===1){const hr=historyHeader[0],markers=['直近1','直近2','直近3'].map(x=>label([hr],x)[0]);const nameHead=label(all,'直近成績').filter(x=>x.y<hr.y&&hr.y-x.y<25);if(markers.every(Boolean)&&nameHead.length===1){const numberRows=all.filter(row=>row.y>hr.y&&row.y<hr.y+carRows.length*18&&row.items.some(x=>x.x<70&&/^\d$/.test(compact(x.text))));for(const row of numberRows){const nums=row.items.filter(x=>x.x<70&&/^\d$/.test(compact(x.text)));if(nums.length!==1)continue;const fact=facts.find(x=>x.number===Number(compact(nums[0].text)));if(!fact)continue;const body=page.items.filter(x=>Math.abs(x.y-row.y)<6),groups=[];for(let j=0;j<3;j++){const left=markers[j].x-53,right=j<2?markers[j+1].x-53:page.width;const cells=body.filter(x=>x.x>=left&&x.x<right);groups.push({raw:cells.map(x=>x.text).join(' '),cells,finish:null,missingReason:'着順は図形の可能性があり文字層から安全に復元できません'});}fact.recentMeetings=groups;}}}
  const lines={notation:'',direction:'LEADER_TO_FOLLOWER',status:'UNKNOWN'},lineRows=all.filter(r=>/^(?:予想ライン|ライン予想|予想並び|並び予想)[:：]/.test(r.compact));if(lineRows.length>1)fail(prefix+'ライン記載が重複');if(lineRows.length){const notation=norm(lineRows[0].text).replace(/^.*?[:：]\s*/, '').trim();RaceIdentityCore.parseLines(notation,entries.map(e=>e.number),'PREDICTED');lines.notation=notation;lines.status='PREDICTED';}
  let printedAt=null,printedRaw=null;for(const row of all){const m=norm(row.text).match(/(?:印刷日時|印刷時刻)\s*[:：]?\s*(\d{4})[\/年-](\d{1,2})[\/月-](\d{1,2})日?\s+(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::(\d{2}))?/);if(m){if(printedRaw!==null)fail(prefix+'印刷日時が重複');printedRaw=row.text;printedAt=m[1]+'-'+m[2].padStart(2,'0')+'-'+m[3].padStart(2,'0')+'T'+m[4].padStart(2,'0')+':'+m[5]+':'+(m[6]||'00')+'+09:00';}}
  if(printedAt){try{time(printedAt,'印刷');if(Date.parse(printedAt)>Date.parse(ctx.checkedAt))warnings.push('印刷日時の申告が実取込より未来です。原票の時計は未検証');}catch{warnings.push('印刷日時を解釈できません。原表記を保持');printedAt=null;}}
  const source={sourceId:'pdf-'+document.fingerprint.slice(0,20),reference:'ローカルPDF '+ctx.fileName+' / SHA256 '+document.fingerprint+' / ページ'+page.number,checkedAt:ctx.checkedAt,availableAt:ctx.acquiredAt,kind:'AI_EXTRACTED',independentFromCandidate:false};
  const card={sport:'keirin',raceId:'LOCAL:'+meta.date+':'+meta.venue+':'+meta.raceNo,...meta,count,numberType:'ENTRANT_NUMBER',entries,source,lines};
  const evidence={format:FORMAT,adapter:VERSION,dataKind:kind,page:page.number,tableRegion:{headerTop:h.name.y,bodyStart:h.bottom,end:Number.isFinite(h.end)?h.end:page.height,ignoredNameHeadings:h.headingCount-1,compositeMetadata:h.composite},officialRaceId:null,race:{...meta,count,localRaceId:card.raceId,headerCells:clone(page.items.filter(x=>x.y<h.bottom))},countBasis:'OBSERVED_CONTIGUOUS_CAR_ROWS_NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED',source:{documentSHA256:document.fingerprint,fileName:ctx.fileName,providerClaim:'KEIRIN.JP print candidate; authenticity NOT_VERIFIED',glyphProfile:'NFKC plus PDF radicals DOOR/WEST/LONG -> Japanese glyphs; raw cells preserved',acquiredAt:ctx.acquiredAt,checkedAt:ctx.checkedAt,printedAt,printedRaw,publishedAt:null,updatedAt:null,preRaceAvailableAt:null,timeZoneProfile:'Asia/Tokyo (print-profile assumption, not timestamp authentication)',legacyAvailableAtMeaning:'LOCAL_FILE_OBSERVED_AT; not proof of pre-race publication'},rows:facts,normalizations,warnings};
  return {card,ratings,conditions:{bankLengthMetres:null,raceClass:null},identity:null,v2:null,features:null,pdfEvidence:evidence};
 }
 function parse(document,ctx){
  if(!document||!Array.isArray(document.pages)||!document.pages.length||document.pages.length>50||!/^([a-f0-9]{64})$/.test(document.fingerprint||''))fail('PDFページ/ハッシュが不正');time(ctx.acquiredAt,'ファイル取得');time(ctx.checkedAt,'検証');if(Date.parse(ctx.acquiredAt)>Date.parse(ctx.checkedAt))fail('取得と検証の時刻が逆転');if(typeof ctx.fileName!=='string'||!ctx.fileName||ctx.fileName.length>300)fail('ファイル名が不正');
  let kind=null;const races=[],seen=new Set();let total=0;
  for(const page of document.pages){if(!Number.isInteger(page.number)||page.number<1||!Number.isFinite(page.width)||!Number.isFinite(page.height)||page.width<=0||page.height<=0||!Array.isArray(page.items)||page.items.length>50000)fail('ページの座標情報が不足/不正');const ids=new Set();
   for(const item of page.items){if(typeof item.text!=='string'||typeof item.id!=='string'||ids.has(item.id)||['x','y','width','height'].some(k=>!Number.isFinite(item[k]))||item.x<0||item.y<0||item.x>page.width+2||item.y>page.height+2||item.width<0||item.height<0||item.text.includes('\uFFFD'))fail('文字/座標/項目IDが不正');ids.add(item.id);total+=new TextEncoder().encode(item.text).length;}if(total>RaceImportCore.MAX)fail('文字数上限');
   const fixture=page.items.some(i=>norm(i.text).includes('RACELAB_TEST_FIXTURE_ONLY')),current=fixture?'TEST_FIXTURE':'REAL';if(kind&&kind!==current)fail('REAL/TEST_FIXTUREページの混在');kind=current;
   try{const sorted={...page,items:page.items.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.y-b.y||a.x-b.x||a.id.localeCompare(b.id))},r=parsePage(sorted,document,ctx,current),key=r.card.raceId;if(seen.has(key))fail('重複レース（ページ継続を推測結合しない）');seen.add(key);races.push(r);}catch(e){if(e.message.startsWith('PDF HOLD:'))throw e;fail(page.number+'ページ: '+e.message);}
  }
  return RaceImportCore.validate({format:RaceImportCore.FORMAT,dataKind:kind,policy:null,races});
 }
 function validateEvidence(e,card,kind){
  if(!e||e.format!==FORMAT||![VERSION,'KEIRINJP_PRINT_CANDIDATE_1'].includes(e.adapter)||e.dataKind!==kind||e.officialRaceId!==null||!e.source||!Array.isArray(e.rows)||e.rows.length!==card.count)fail('PDF根拠の版/区分/行数が不正');
  if(!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(e.source.documentSHA256)||card.source.sourceId!=='pdf-'+e.source.documentSHA256.slice(0,20)||e.source.checkedAt!==card.source.checkedAt||e.source.acquiredAt!==card.source.availableAt)fail('PDF根拠の出所/観測時刻が不一致');
  if(!e.race||['date','venue','raceNo','startsAt','count'].some(k=>e.race[k]!==card[k])||e.race.localRaceId!==card.raceId)fail('PDF根拠とレース条件が不一致');
  for(const field of ['publishedAt','updatedAt','preRaceAvailableAt'])if(e.source[field]!==null)fail('未確認の公表/更新/事前時刻をPDFから補完できません');
  const evidenceName=e.adapter==='KEIRINJP_PRINT_CANDIDATE_1'?s=>s.normalize('NFKC').replace(/\s+/gu,''):nameText;
  const seen=new Set();for(const row of e.rows){const entrant=card.entries.find(x=>x.number===row.number);if(seen.has(row.number)||!entrant||entrant.name!==row.name||evidenceName(row.rawName)!==row.name||!Array.isArray(row.nameCells)||!row.nameCells.length||!Array.isArray(row.numberCells)||!row.numberCells.length||evidenceName(row.nameCells.map(x=>x.text).join(''))!==row.name||compact(row.numberCells.map(x=>x.text).join(''))!==String(row.number))fail('PDF根拠と番号・氏名が不一致');seen.add(row.number);if(row.observed!==undefined)RaceObservedStats.validate(row.observed);if(row.competitionScore?.meaning!=='PDF_LISTED_COMPETITION_SCORE_NOT_ABILITY'||row.competitionScore.value!==null&&(!Number.isFinite(row.competitionScore.value)||row.competitionScore.value<0))fail('PDF掲載競走得点の形式が不正');}
  return e;
 }
 function matches(document){return document.pages.some(p=>{const s=p.items?rows(p.items).map(r=>r.compact).join(''):compact(p.text||'');return s.includes('競輪場')&&(s.includes('選手名')&&s.includes('競走')&&s.includes('得点')||/keirin\.jp/i.test(s)&&s.includes('発走予定'));});}
 return Object.freeze({VERSION,FORMAT,parse,matches,validateEvidence});
})();

</script>
<script id="keirin-scenario">
'use strict';
globalThis.RaceKeirinScenario=(()=>{
 const I=RaceIdentityCore,required=['lead','makuri','sashi','position','stamina','form'];
 const config=Object.freeze({id:'KEIRIN_FEATURE_SCENARIO_V1',calibration:'NOT_ESTABLISHED',initiativeWeights:{lead:0.6,position:0.2,stamina:0.2},contestMargin:12,attackWeights:{makuri:0.65,position:0.2,form:0.15},formWeight:0.12,recentFinishWeight:0.05,tacticBias:4,lateChoiceMakuriStronger:0.7,lateChoiceOtherwise:0.3,breakLineChanceScale:0.35,controlledLoad:4,contestedLoad:8,positionPenalty:5,lateAttackFactor:1.2,earlyAttackFactor:0.6,draftSecond:2.4,draftThird:1.2,chaseWeight:0.05,notice:'全係数は開発用の仮定。既存選手マスター/公式バンク補正への接続や実戦校正はしていません。'});
 function prepare(r,p,ctx){if(r.card.sport!=='keirin')throw Error('競輪専用の展開モデルです');if(!Array.isArray(r.features)||r.features.length!==r.card.count)throw Error('根拠付き特徴量が全員分ありません。未確認を補完しません');const lines=I.parseLines(r.card.lines.notation,r.card.entries.map(e=>e.number),r.card.lines.status);if(!lines.groups.length)throw Error('ラインが不明です。展開計算は保留');const riders=[],seen=new Set(),cutoff=Date.parse(r.card.source.checkedAt),start=Date.parse(r.card.startsAt);
  const sourceTime=(x,label)=>{if(!x||!p.policy.sources.some(s=>s.id===x.sourceId)||typeof x.reference!=='string'||!x.reference.trim())throw Error(label+'の出所/根拠が不明');for(const k of ['publishedAt','acquiredAt','availableAt'])if(typeof x[k]!=='string'||!/^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d(?:Z|[+-]\d\d:\d\d)$/.test(x[k])||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(x[k]))||Date.parse(x[k])>cutoff||Date.parse(x[k])>=start||Date.parse(x[k])>Date.parse(ctx.now))throw Error(label+'の時刻が未確認/事後/未来');if(Date.parse(x.publishedAt)>Date.parse(x.availableAt)||Date.parse(x.acquiredAt)>Date.parse(x.availableAt)||x.phase!=='PRE_RACE')throw Error(label+'の公表/利用可能/取得時刻/事前区分が不整合');};
  for(const f of r.features){const e=r.card.entries.find(e=>e.number===f.number);if(!e||seen.has(f.number)||e.name!==f.name||e.stableId!==f.stableId)throw Error('特徴量と番号/名前/安定IDの対応不一致');seen.add(f.number);if(!['先行','捲り','差し','自在','追込'].includes(f.tactic))throw Error(e.number+'番の戦法が未確認');const m={};for(const id of required){const v=f.metrics?.[id];sourceTime(v,e.number+'番 '+id);if(!Number.isFinite(v.value)||v.value<0||v.value>100||typeof v.evidence!=='string'||!v.evidence.trim())throw Error(e.number+'番 '+id+'の根拠付き値が未確認');m[id]=v.value;}if(!Array.isArray(f.history)||f.history.length<3||f.history.length>5)throw Error(e.number+'番の直近3〜5走が未確認');for(const h of f.history){if(!/^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d$/.test(h.date)||h.date>=r.card.date||!Number.isInteger(h.finish)||!Number.isInteger(h.field)||h.finish<1||h.finish>h.field||h.field<2||h.field>9)throw Error(e.number+'番の履歴着順/頭数/日付が不正');sourceTime(h,e.number+'番の履歴');if(typeof h.opposition!=='string'||!h.opposition.trim())throw Error('相手関係が未確認の履歴は展開モデル保留');}const score=r.ratings.find(a=>a.number===e.number)?.score;if(score===null||score===undefined)throw Error(e.number+'番の個人能力点が未評価');const group=lines.groups.findIndex(g=>g.includes(e.number)),place=lines.groups[group].indexOf(e.number)+1; const recentFinishIndex=100*f.history.reduce((sum,h)=>sum+(h.field-h.finish)/(h.field-1),0)/f.history.length;riders.push({number:e.number,name:e.name,ability:score,recentFinishIndex,m,tactic:f.tactic,group,place,solo:lines.groups[group].length===1,history:f.history});}
  return {riders,lines,config};
 }
 function trial(p,rng,sigma){const G=RacePocCore.gaussian,riders=p.riders,leaders=riders.filter(r=>r.place===1).map(r=>({r,initiative:0.6*r.m.lead+0.2*r.m.position+0.2*r.m.stamina+(r.tactic==='先行'?4:0)+sigma*G(rng)})).sort((a,b)=>b.initiative-a.initiative||a.r.number-b.r.number),controller=leaders[0].r,contenders=leaders.filter(l=>leaders[0].initiative-l.initiative<=config.contestMargin),contested=contenders.length>1;
  const attackCandidates=riders.filter(r=>r.place===1||(['捲り','自在'].includes(r.tactic)&&rng()<config.breakLineChanceScale*r.m.position/100));const attacker=attackCandidates.map(r=>({r,power:0.65*r.m.makuri+0.2*r.m.position+0.15*r.m.form+(r.tactic==='捲り'?4:0)+sigma*G(rng)})).sort((a,b)=>b.power-a.power||a.r.number-b.r.number)[0].r;
  const late=rng()<(attacker.m.makuri>attacker.m.lead?config.lateChoiceMakuriStronger:config.lateChoiceOtherwise),slots=riders.map(r=>({number:r.number,target:leaders.findIndex(l=>l.r.group===r.group)*2+r.place-1-r.m.position/100+G(rng)*0.7})).sort((a,b)=>a.target-b.target||a.number-b.number);
  const states=riders.map(r=>{const slot=slots.findIndex(s=>s.number===r.number)+1,leader=riders.find(x=>x.group===r.group&&x.place===1),leaderSlot=slots.findIndex(s=>s.number===leader.number)+1,formEffect=config.formWeight*(r.m.form-50),recentEffect=config.recentFinishWeight*(r.recentFinishIndex-50),noise=sigma*G(rng),personal=r.ability+formEffect+recentEffect+noise,positionEffect=-config.positionPenalty*(slot-1)/Math.max(1,riders.length-1),effortEffect=contenders.some(x=>x.r.number===r.number)?-(contested?config.contestedLoad:config.controlledLoad)*(1-r.m.stamina/150):0,attackEffect=r.number===attacker.number?0.1*r.m.makuri*(late?config.lateAttackFactor:config.earlyAttackFactor):0,nearLeader=slot>leaderSlot&&slot-leaderSlot<=3,draftEffect=nearLeader&&!r.solo?(r.place===2?config.draftSecond:r.place===3?config.draftThird:0)*(leader.number===controller.number?1:0.5):0,chaseEffect=r.place>1&&nearLeader?r.m.sashi*config.chaseWeight:0;return {number:r.number,action:r.number===attacker.number?'ATTACK':contenders.some(x=>x.r.number===r.number)?'LEAD_CONTEST':'FOLLOW_OR_POSITION',slotPhase:'BEFORE_ATTACK',ability:r.ability,formEffect,recentEffect,noise,recentFinishIndex:r.recentFinishIndex,role:r.solo?'SOLO':r.place===1?'LEADER':r.place===2?'SECOND':r.place===3?'THIRD':'FOLLOWER',slot,personal,positionEffect,effortEffect,attackEffect,draftEffect,chaseEffect,finalScore:personal+positionEffect+effortEffect+attackEffect+draftEffect+chaseEffect};});
  const order=states.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.finalScore-a.finalScore||a.number-b.number).map(r=>r.number);return {controller:controller.number,attacker:attacker.number,attackCandidates:attackCandidates.map(r=>r.number),attackTiming:late?'LATE':'EARLY',state:contested?'CONTESTED':'CONTROLLED',contenders:contenders.map(x=>x.r.number),order,riders:states};
 }
 return Object.freeze({required,config,prepare,trial});
})();

</script>
<script id="simulation-core">
'use strict';
globalThis.RaceSimulationCore=(()=>{
 const K=RaceImportCore,Q=RaceQualityCore,clone=x=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x));
 function run(input,index,options,ctx){const pack=K.validate(input),q=K.inspect(pack,index,ctx);if(!q.ready)throw Error('HOLD: '+q.errors.join(' / '));const r=pack.races[index],o=clone(options);if(!Number.isInteger(o.runs)||o.runs<1||o.runs>100000)throw Error('試行回数は1〜100000の整数です');if(!['RATING','UNIFORM','KEIRIN_SCENARIO'].includes(o.model)||typeof o.seed!=='string'||!o.seed.length||o.seed.length>200)throw Error('モデル/シードが不正');if(!Number.isFinite(o.sigma)||o.sigma<0.1||o.sigma>50)throw Error('共通ぶれは0.1〜50');if(!Array.isArray(o.adjustments))throw Error('展開補正が不正');const seen=new Set();for(const a of o.adjustments){if(Object.keys(a).sort().join(',')!=='delta,number'||!r.card.entries.some(e=>e.number===a.number)||seen.has(a.number)||!Number.isFinite(a.delta)||Math.abs(a.delta)>30)throw Error('展開補正の番号重複/未知/範囲外');seen.add(a.number);}if(o.model==='KEIRIN_SCENARIO'&&o.adjustments.length)throw Error('特徴量展開モデルでは別の手動補正を混入しません');if(o.model==='UNIFORM'&&o.adjustments.length)throw Error('均等仮定に展開補正は使用しません');if(o.model!=='UNIFORM'&&r.ratings.some(e=>e.score===null))throw Error('能力点の未評価があります。入力するか能力を使用しない均等仮定を選択してください');
  const prepared=o.model==='KEIRIN_SCENARIO'?RaceKeirinScenario.prepare(r,pack,ctx):null,scenario=prepared?{model:RaceKeirinScenario.config,controlled:0,contested:0,earlyAttacks:0,lateAttacks:0,controlCounts:r.card.entries.map(e=>({number:e.number,count:0})),attackCounts:r.card.entries.map(e=>({number:e.number,count:0})),positionTotals:r.card.entries.map(e=>({number:e.number,total:0})),example:null}:null;
  const n=r.card.entries.length,rng=RacePocCore.seededRandom(o.seed),entries=r.card.entries.map(e=>{const a=r.ratings.find(a=>a.number===e.number),d=o.adjustments.find(a=>a.number===e.number)?.delta||0;return {name:e.name,rating:a.score===null?null:a.score+d,sigma:a.sigma??o.sigma};}),ranks=entries.map(()=>Array(n).fill(0)),combos=new Map();let example=[];const comboScenarios=new Map();
  for(let t=0;t<o.runs;t++){let order,event=null;if(prepared){event=RaceKeirinScenario.trial(prepared,rng,o.sigma);order=event.order.map(n=>r.card.entries.findIndex(e=>e.number===n));scenario[event.state==='CONTESTED'?'contested':'controlled']++;scenario[event.attackTiming==='LATE'?'lateAttacks':'earlyAttacks']++;scenario.controlCounts.find(x=>x.number===event.controller).count++;scenario.attackCounts.find(x=>x.number===event.attacker).count++;for(const e of event.riders)scenario.positionTotals.find(x=>x.number===e.number).total+=e.slot;if(!scenario.example)scenario.example=event;}else if(o.model==='UNIFORM'){order=Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>i);for(let i=n-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(rng()*(i+1));[order[i],order[j]]=[order[j],order[i]];}}else order=RacePocCore.sampleFinish(entries,rng);if(t===0)example=order.map(i=>r.card.entries[i].number);for(let pos=0;pos<n;pos++)ranks[order[pos]][pos]++;const key=order.slice(0,3).map(i=>r.card.entries[i].number).join('-');combos.set(key,(combos.get(key)||0)+1);if(event){if(!comboScenarios.has(key))comboScenarios.set(key,{controlled:0,contested:0,firstTrace:event});const c=comboScenarios.get(key);c[event.state==='CONTESTED'?'contested':'controlled']++;}}
  const stats=r.card.entries.map((e,i)=>({number:e.number,name:e.name,rankCounts:ranks[i],win:ranks[i][0],top2:ranks[i].slice(0,2).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0),top3:ranks[i].slice(0,3).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0),averageRank:ranks[i].reduce((s,c,j)=>s+c*(j+1),0)/o.runs}));const combinations=[...combos].map(([key,count])=>({key,count,frequency:count/o.runs,...(scenario?{scenarioCounts:{controlled:comboScenarios.get(key).controlled,contested:comboScenarios.get(key).contested},firstTrace:comboScenarios.get(key).firstTrace}:{})})).sort((a,b)=>b.count-a.count||a.key.localeCompare(b.key)).slice(0,12);
  const body={format:K.RUN,dataKind:pack.dataKind,modelVersion:prepared?'KEIRIN_FEATURE_SCENARIO_V1':o.model==='UNIFORM'?'UNIFORM_PERMUTATION_1':'POC_INDEPENDENT_NORMAL_1_IMPORT_1',executedAt:ctx.now,temporalStatus:Date.parse(ctx.now)<Date.parse(r.card.startsAt)?'RECORDED_BEFORE_START_SELF_DECLARED':'RETROSPECTIVE_ANALYSIS',raceIndex:index,inputHash:Q.hash(pack),inputs:pack,options:o,stats,combinations,example,scenario,notice:'未校正のモデル発生頻度。実測的中率・勝率保証・購入推奨ではありません。能力点と展開補正は別の仮定です。端末時刻とSHAは第三者の事前時刻証明ではありません。'};return {...body,contentHash:Q.hash(body)};
 }
 function compareLineRuns(a,b,ctx){if(!a?.inputs||!b?.inputs)throw Error('比較用の実行記録が不足');const x=K.restoreRun(JSON.stringify(a),a.inputs,ctx),y=K.restoreRun(JSON.stringify(b),b.inputs,ctx);if(x.options.model!=='KEIRIN_SCENARIO'||y.options.model!=='KEIRIN_SCENARIO'||Q.hash(x.options)!==Q.hash(y.options))throw Error('比較には同じモデル・シード・試行条件が必要です');const r=x.inputs.races[x.raceIndex],s=y.inputs.races[y.raceIndex];if(x.dataKind!==y.dataKind||!r||!s||Q.hash({...r.card,lines:s.card.lines})!==Q.hash(s.card)||['identity','v2','ratings','features','conditions'].some(k=>Q.hash(r[k])!==Q.hash(s[k])))throw Error('比較の出走者・基礎能力・特徴量または条件が異なります');if(Q.hash(r.card.lines)===Q.hash(s.card.lines))throw Error('異なるラインを選択してください');const rows=x.stats.map(a=>{const b=y.stats.find(z=>z.number===a.number),pa=x.scenario.positionTotals.find(z=>z.number===a.number),pb=y.scenario.positionTotals.find(z=>z.number===a.number);if(!b||!pa||!pb)throw Error('比較対象の選手が不一致');return {number:a.number,name:a.name,winA:a.win,winB:b.win,top2A:a.top2,top2B:b.top2,top3A:a.top3,top3B:b.top3,positionA:pa.total/x.options.runs,positionB:pb.total/y.options.runs};});return {runs:x.options.runs,seed:x.options.seed,lines:{A:r.card.lines,B:s.card.lines},rows,traces:{A:x.scenario.example,B:y.scenario.example},controllers:{A:x.scenario.controlCounts,B:y.scenario.controlCounts},notice:'同一仮定の発生頻度比較。実測精度や勝率の証明ではありません。V2原評価の旧ライン所見は新ラインの根拠に流用しません。'};}
 return Object.freeze({run,compareLineRuns});
})();

</script>
<script id="import-fixtures">
'use strict';
globalThis.RaceImportFixtures=(()=>{
 const J=RaceIdentityFixtures,I=RaceIdentityCore,B=globalThis.RaceIdentityBase||{},M=B.M||RaceManualCore,F=B.F||RaceStudyFixtures;
 const at='2026-10-26T00:00:00+09:00';
 function pack(sport='keirin',n=7){const f=J.fixture(sport,n);let identity=f.identity;for(const e of identity.reference.entries)identity=I.review(identity,e.number,'TEST_FIXTURE_AUTHOR','examples/CC0_IDENTITY_ROSTER.md / '+e.number+'番',at);const c={now:at,storagePath:'C:\\RaceLabLocal\\manual',confirmedUnsynced:true},a=F.simulated(f.numerical,c),v2=(B.C||RaceStudyCore).quality(f.preparation,JSON.stringify(a),c).book;return {format:'RACELAB_IMPORT_PACK_V1',dataKind:'TEST_FIXTURE',policy:f.preparation.policy,races:[{card:f.candidate,ratings:v2.analysis.races[0].runners.map(e=>({number:e.number,score:e.evaluation.totalScore,sigma:null,style:e.facts.find(f=>f.topic==='style')?.text||'',notes:'TEST_FIXTURE / 元V2の手作成スコア。実AIではない'})),conditions:f.preparation.race.conditions,identity,v2,features:null}]};}
 function scenario(n=7){const p=pack('keirin',n),r=p.races[0],profiles=[[80,69,50,75,81,83],[68,87,56,69,78,79],[91,77,66,84,90,88],[72,82,85,76,82,84],[42,40,48,55,58,44],[45,55,91,83,71,78],[61,66,62,65,63,60],[79,72,67,81,76,79],[65,67,62,64,70,65]],ids=['lead','makuri','sashi','position','stamina','form'];r.features=r.card.entries.map((e,i)=>{const values=profiles[i],ref={sourceId:r.card.source.sourceId,reference:'TEST_FIXTURE / 独自架空特徴量・履歴資料 '+e.number,publishedAt:r.card.source.availableAt,availableAt:r.card.source.checkedAt,acquiredAt:r.card.source.checkedAt,phase:'PRE_RACE'};return {number:e.number,name:e.name,stableId:e.stableId,tactic:['先行','捲り','自在','捲り','追込','差し','自在','先行','自在'][i],metrics:Object.fromEntries(ids.map((id,j)=>[id,{...ref,value:values[j],evidence:'TEST_FIXTURE: 人工的な'+id+'評価。実在選手・実績・校正済み指標ではない'}])),history:[2,4,1,3].map((finish,j)=>({...ref,date:'2026-09-'+String(28-j*4).padStart(2,'0'),finish:Math.min(finish,n),field:n,opposition:'独自架空の同クラス'}))};});return p;}
 function multi(){const a=scenario(7);for(const [s,n]of[['keirin',9],['horse',18]])a.races.push((s==='keirin'?scenario(n):pack(s,n)).races[0]);return a;}
 return Object.freeze({pack,scenario,multi});
})();

<script id="pdf-loader">
'use strict';
globalThis.RacePDF=(()=>{
 let library=null;
 const bytes=id=>Uint8Array.from(atob(document.getElementById(id).textContent.trim()),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));
 async function load(){if(globalThis.RacePDFEmbedded)return globalThis.RacePDFEmbedded;if(!library)library=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const wait=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('PDFエンジンを初期化できません。一括貼付を使用できます')),5000);globalThis.addEventListener('racelab:pdf-ready',()=>{clearTimeout(wait);resolve(globalThis.RacePDFEmbedded);},{once:true});});return library;}
 async function extract(file){if(file.size>10*1024*1024)throw Error('PDFは10MiB以内です');const input=new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer());if(new TextDecoder('ascii').decode(input.slice(0,5))!=='%PDF-')throw Error('PDFの実体ではありません');const fingerprint=RaceSHA256Bytes(input);const pdf=await load();class OfflineDataFactory{async fetch(){throw Error('このPDFが必要とする追加辞書/フォントには未対応です。外部取得はしません');}}
  const workerURL=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes('pdfjs-worker-data')],{type:'text/javascript'})),port=new Worker(workerURL),worker=new pdf.PDFWorker({port});const task=pdf.getDocument({worker,data:input,disableAutoFetch:true,disableRange:true,disableStream:true,useWorkerFetch:false,useWasm:false,isEvalSupported:false,disableFontFace:true,useSystemFonts:false,enableXfa:false,BinaryDataFactory:OfflineDataFactory,stopAtErrors:true,verbosity:0});let doc,timer;const timeout=new Promise((_,reject)=>{timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('PDF読取が30秒以内に完了しません。一括貼付を使用してください')),30000);port.addEventListener('error',()=>reject(Error('PDF作業用エンジンを起動できません。一括貼付を使用してください')),{once:true});});
  try{doc=await Promise.race([task.promise,timeout]);if(doc.numPages>50)throw Error('PDFは50ページ以内です');const pages=[];let size=0;for(let n=1;n<=doc.numPages;n++){const page=await Promise.race([doc.getPage(n),timeout]),content=await Promise.race([page.getTextContent({disableNormalization:true}),timeout]),rows=[],geometry=[],viewport=page.getViewport({scale:1}),v=viewport.transform;if(content.items.length>30000)throw Error('1ページの文字項目が上限を超えました');for(const [itemIndex,t] of content.items.entries()){if(typeof t.str!=='string'||!t.str.trim())continue;geometry.push({id:'p'+n+'-'+itemIndex,text:t.str,x:v[0]*t.transform[4]+v[2]*t.transform[5]+v[4],y:v[1]*t.transform[4]+v[3]*t.transform[5]+v[5],width:t.width,height:t.height});const y=Math.round(t.transform[5]*2)/2;let row=rows.find(r=>Math.abs(r.y-y)<2);if(!row){row={y,items:[]};rows.push(row);}row.items.push({x:t.transform[4],text:t.str});}rows.sort((a,b)=>b.y-a.y);const text=rows.map(r=>r.items.sort((a,b)=>a.x-b.x).map(x=>x.text).join('\t')).join('\n');size+=new TextEncoder().encode(text).length;if(size>RaceImportCore.MAX)throw Error('抽出文字が2MiBを超えました');pages.push({number:n,text,width:viewport.width,height:viewport.height,rotation:viewport.rotation,items:geometry});page.cleanup();}if(pages.every(p=>!p.text.trim()))throw Error('文字層のないPDFです。画像OCRは未対応です。ChatGPTが整理したJSON/テキストを一括貼付できます');return {pages,text:pages.map(p=>p.text).join('\n'),fingerprint,version:pdf.version};}
  catch(e){if(e.name==='PasswordException')throw Error('暗号化/パスワード付きPDFは未対応です。解除済みで利用可能な資料か構造化テキストを使用してください');throw e;}finally{clearTimeout(timer);port.terminate();worker.destroy();URL.revokeObjectURL(workerURL);task.destroy().catch(()=>{});}
 }
 return Object.freeze({extract});
})();

</script>
